metadata.title: Symphonic Joins and Finite-Product Hopf Constructions
metadata.abstract: We study how collapse at the ends of a warped product affects symphonic joins and Hopf constructions. For a Hopf construction with a fixed angular map on a finite product of closed Riemannian manifolds, we characterize when the reduced energy has infimum zero among functions connecting the two target poles. Under linear collapse this occurs precisely when, at some end, the collapsing factors have total dimension greater than three, or have total dimension three and vanishing angular density on the collapsing block. In either case the infimum is unattained. For ellipsoidal joins with nonconstant spherical factor maps, smooth extension of a connecting symphonic join forces each factor map to be the restriction of a linear isometric embedding. We also derive the coupled equations for orthogonally split targets, establish a convexity criterion for minimizing separated joins, and construct smooth quaternionic examples with all angular factors active.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 有限乘积 Hopf 构造的端点塌缩与 symphonic join
analysis.workSummary: 固定闭黎曼流形有限乘积的角向映射，研究连接目标两极的约化能量。在线性塌缩下，无穷小能量恰发生于某端塌缩维数和大于 3，或等于 3 且该塌缩块的角密度消失时。
techniques: 约化能量与连接两极的测试路径
椭球 join 的光滑延拓
正交分裂目标的耦合方程
analysis.breakthrough: 上述零下确界均不取到。非恒定球面因子参与的椭球 join 若可光滑延拓，各因子映射必须来自线性等距嵌入。另给分离式 join 的极小凸性判据及四元数构造。
analysis.limitations: 维数阈值依赖线性塌缩、固定角向映射及约化能量类，延拓刚性适用于题述椭球球面因子。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露生成式 AI（包括 OpenAI Codex）用于发展和修订论证、编辑、核查部分公式和文献，以及为若干命题准备 Lean 证明。作者并交代早期工作[2]完成后才用 ChatGPT 改进。第5页 AI 的命中是以 I 为分量指标的方程符号。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.22845v1 · PDF 第50页 AI assistance
